quotes.text: The Psalmist asked the question, “How shall we sing the Lord’s song in a strange land?” (Psalm 137:4). In every age, including our own, the Lord’s message has been brought into lands that were strange to the messengers. They have sought to establish a Zion where the Lord is God.
quotes.speaker: James E. Faust
quotes.attr: James E. Faust, in Conference Report, Oct. 1979, 133; or Ensign, Nov. 1979, 91

notes: This psalm was perhaps composed by David when he was newly advanced to his throne, 2 Sam. 5, 1 Chron. 12.
